thread:
maya: saw a bump in unassigned leads after the enrichment roll this morning. SLA alert fired. anyone on it? :eyes:
noah: looks like enrichment timeouts cause rr slot to expire. several leads fall through to unassigned fallback.
leah: we cut enrich TTL from 60s -> 25s last sprint to reduce latency. this makes the race worse when backend blips.
hubspot-bot: metric.alert: inbound.handoff.unassigned_rate=5.8% window=15m source=hs-sync
tess: proposal: add a short staging window (60s) so leads wait for enrich before falling through. if enrich still fails, route to overflow but tag as "awaiting_enrich" and hold from outbound for 30m.
noah: simple router change: add state STAGING (ttl=60s) + emit metric inbound.handoff.staging_count. canary 5%.
maya: +1. owners? noah -> code + canary, leah -> HS/SF mapping tweaks, tess -> overflow rules + doc, me -> ops comms. rollback if unassigned_rate > 2x baseline in 15m.
noah: canary config snippet:
```
router.round_robin = {
  staging_enabled: true,
  staging_ttl_secs: 60,
  canary_pct: 5
}
```
leah: will add mapping rule to defer owner write until enrich completes or after 30m. prevents owner churn.
tess: I'll add dashboard flag and update the SDR playbook to skip "awaiting_enrich" leads.
maya: schedule canary at 11:15 UTC. ping here with deltas. :rocket:
